book.name: Book cipher
book.desc: A note of numbers: paragraph, word and letter in a book the players must guess

field.bookTitleHint: For example: Chronicles of the White Spire
field.sourceHint: Paste an excerpt: a chronicle, a prayer, a tale. Each line is a paragraph; blank lines don't count.
field.sourceTip: A word is letters only: hyphenated counts as one word, numbers and punctuation don't count.
field.phraseHint: What the players will read. Words found in the book are encoded whole, the rest letter by letter.
field.modeTip: “paragraph.word” is a whole word, “paragraph.word.letter” is one letter of that word

problem.empty: Paste the book text and type a phrase — the note will build itself.
problem.noBook: Paste the book text: the players will count words in it.
problem.noPhrase: Type a phrase: it will be encoded as word numbers from the book.
problem.noLetter: The book has no letter “{letter}”, needed for “{word}”. Add a word with it to the book or change the phrase.
problem.noLetters: The book has no letters {letters}, needed for the phrase. Add words with them to the book or change the phrase.
problem.unknown: The note didn't build. Check the book and the phrase.

code.key: The key is the book “{title}”. Numbers: paragraph.word, a third number is the letter in the word.
code.keyUntitled: The key is the book given to the players. Numbers: paragraph.word, a third number is the letter in the word.

preview.numbersTip: Paragraph and word numbers — check the count

view.hintFull: The numbers on the note are paragraph, word and letter in the word. Click a word in the book to mark it; click again to unmark.
view.hintBook: Click a word to mark it; click again to unmark.
view.hintNote: A note of nothing but numbers. Somewhere there is a book they fit.
